_note: Placements that are meant to look this way. tools\cli audit placement skips a problem whose kind matches and whose name or prefab matches the regex (docs/placement-audit.md). Give the reason a reviewer can check in a shot.

allow.why: The vault door is the prefab's own child (VaultDoor) on its hinge pivot, seated in the frame ring of VaultFront by design; in the _Open vault it stands on the same hinge beside the frame (tools/assets/bank-vault, #925). The town vault swings it open with the breach state.
The quarry axe lies flat on the ground by the logs (LoggingChain.layer angles 90).
The small money bag on the bank floor is meant to be small (#740).
The cash stack is the bag prefab's child, drawn inside the 0.4-scale bag the way the town bag is (#323 batch 0).
The annex twin of the bank bell box hangs 1.5 m up beside the twin vault door: the annex has no wall for it, and the alarm mount test only needs the box above its door (#323 batch 0).
The teller stands on the bank wall plinth (y 0.16) behind the counter; the terrain probe misses the plinth. Seen in the Bank_Teller close-up, #679.

Vanilla has no cabbage-head mesh, only the whole-plant CabbageCrop_01 (0.84 x 0.91 m at scale 1). Cabbage.et scales it to 0.5, so the plant measures 0.46 m, inside the cabbage 0.15-0.6 m range. A larger scale would put a 0.9 m plant on a stall table.
